speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information; the timing of the rash starting last night alongside a new cough and recent arthritis management is significant. Have you noticed any specific shape to the rash, such as target-like lesions, or any swelling/redness around your joints?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome (SJS) / Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (TEN) secondary to recent medication initiation for arthritis.

I have reached my diagnosis based on the triad of sudden onset rash, mucositis, and recent new medication use (likely an aromatic anticonvulsant or NSAID). I will now request images of the rash to confirm the extent of skin detachment and rule out other causes. REQUEST IMAGES
